name: Lens Shape Anomaly

criteria.description: Presence of abnormal lens contour detected by slit-lamp examination or imaging
Refractive errors or visual impairment attributable to lens shape abnormality
Exclusion of other causes of lens abnormalities such as trauma, cataract, or metabolic disorders
Positive family history of lens shape anomalies or related ocular disorders
Confirmation of lens shape anomaly by ultrasound biomicroscopy or anterior segment OCT

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of abnormal lens contour and visual disturbance with exclusion of other etiologies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on clinical examination and imaging; genetic testing may be supportive if available.

searchTerms: lens shape irregularity causing vision issues

pathognomonic.symptomName: Lens shape distortion causing refractive error
searchTerms: distorted lens shape causing vision errors
lens deformation leading to refractive problems

common.symptomName: Astigmatism secondary to lens shape anomaly
searchTerms: blurred vision due to lens shape
cloudy lens after surgery or trauma

imaging: Slit-lamp biomicroscopy revealing abnormal lens contour
Ultrasound biomicroscopy showing lens shape distortion
Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (OCT) confirming lens morphology
genetic: Possible mutations in genes related to lens development (e.g., CRYAA, MAF) in familial cases
other: Refractive error measurements indicating irregular astigmatism
Visual acuity testing demonstrating decreased vision

distinguishingFeatures: Lens displacement rather than shape anomaly
Often associated with systemic connective tissue disorders
Lens opacity present rather than shape distortion
Visual impairment primarily due to opacification

redFlags: Signs of lens dislocation or subluxation
Elevated intraocular pressure indicating secondary glaucoma
references: American Academy of Ophthalmology Basic and Clinical Science Course, Section 7: Pediatric Ophthalmology and Strabismus
Kanski’s Clinical Ophthalmology: A Systematic Approach, 9th Edition
